criteria.text: Only a same-ID check ending unknown with service-restarted permits a replacement with a fresh attempt ID and the original source and call ceiling.
Each Story row gets at most one replacement across repeated or concurrent saved reads and retries.
Recovery preserves both attempts' request IDs, receipts and known or unknown usage.
Waiting through restart recovery avoids repeated source packing while still checking the saved source before an authorized replacement.

Restart aggregation keeps each request ID's known calls, unknown calls and completeness; an incomplete original plus complete replacement stays incomplete. Keep prior raw observations and do not settle them from a later complete-looking receipt because this Runtime contract defines no reconciliation signal.

cases.given: same-ID terminal check unknown/service-restarted; replacement passed
cases.required_observation: 2 distinct IDs, one replacement, original source/cap and both receipts/calls

cases.given: two recoveries see same restart receipt
cases.required_observation: one exclusive replacement claim and one replacement POST total

cases.given: lost POST, wrong-ID/command, generic unknown, expiry separately
owner/source/repo mismatch or deadline/interrupt before claim
cases.required_observation: no replacement ID/POST; preserve prior evidence

cases.given: same eligible confirmed restart is visited twice in one scheduler turn and over later ticks while its replacement waits; supplied source capture counter
cases.required_observation: one capture/hash for that recovery decision, no duplicate packing on the second visit or later pending ticks; one replacement claim/POST maximum, unchanged source and call ceiling

cases.given: new recovery invocation or newly authorized replacement after prior wait; local source changed
cases.required_observation: validate source for the new dispatch decision, refuse changed source before replacement allocation/POST; avoiding repeated packing never removes saved-source equality guard

cases.given: original same-ID service-restarted receipt has calls=2, known_calls=2, unknown_calls=1 and accounting_complete=false; the one replacement has calls=3, known_calls=3, unknown_calls=0 and accounting_complete=true
cases.required_observation: retain both raw receipts; report at least 5 known calls + 1 unknown with no complete numeric total in JSON/text; the incomplete cohort cannot create cache PASS

cases.given: after restart replacement, a complete-looking terminal receipt is read for the original request ID whose earlier correctly identified unknown receipt had incomplete accounting; no reconciliation signal is defined by the Runtime contract
cases.required_observation: preserve the earlier raw observation and unknown accounting for that component; only an explicit future Runtime reconciliation contract may resolve it; local lease release remains separate

cases.given: one request ID has queued and running progress snapshots with partial accounting, followed by a complete terminal receipt
cases.required_observation: preserve raw progress snapshots; use terminal accounting for that ID; allow complete output and cache evidence when the terminal receipt and remaining run evidence are complete

cases.given: same-ID unknown/service-restarted appears in result.refusals and, in a separate case, result.report.refusal; replacement also restarts
cases.required_observation: each first receipt authorizes one replacement only; preserve original max_calls and both IDs; no third possibly-started POST
